title: Mobile Layout Improvements
summary: Made the mobile home screen more compact and consistent, with clearer navigation.

changes.text: Mobile Home Layout: reduced excess spacing and adjusted the scanner upload area to use the available screen height.
Consistent Scanner Panels: Scanner, Video, and AI Vision upload panels now share the same height on mobile.
Mobile Navigation Styling: enlarged the dock icons, assigned each tab a distinct color, and added a matching active-button glow.
Simplified Mobile Footer: hid the fan-project disclaimer on mobile screens.
